sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: CHAPTER 1

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: INTRODUCTION

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: This act establishes basic conditions of employment.

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: SECTION 10

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: OVERTIME WORKING TIME

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (1) An employer may not require or permit an employee to work overtime except—

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (a) in accordance with an agreement; and

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (b) within the limits prescribed in subsection (2).

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (2) An employer may not require or permit an employee to work overtime exceeding—

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (a) ten hours in any week; or

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (b) twelve hours in any day.

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: SECTION 37

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: NOTICE PERIOD

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (1) Notice of termination of employment given by an employer must be—

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (a) at least one week, if the employee has been employed for six months or less;

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (b) at least two weeks, if the employee has been employed for more than six months but not more than one year;

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (c) at least four weeks, if the employee has been employed for more than one year.

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: SECTION 188

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: UNFAIR DISMISSAL PROCEDURES

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (1) A dismissal is unfair if the employer fails to prove—

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (a) that the reason for the dismissal is a fair reason; and

sections.title: Preamble
sections.content: (b) that the dismissal was effected in accordance with a fair procedure.
